proposal.description_long: Published reporting supports a limited social event involving Donald Trump and Robert Maxwell. Politico reported that a May 1989 gossip-column item placed Trump, Robert Maxwell and Ghislaine Maxwell at a party aboard the elder Maxwell’s yacht, the Lady Ghislaine. The item reportedly noted that Trump compared his own yacht with Maxwell’s. The Washington Post separately wrote that Maxwell invited Trump to a party on the yacht, which was named for his daughter. These accounts support a social encounter and do not document a business arrangement, intelligence relationship or criminal conduct. They do not substantiate the supplied timeline’s separate allegations that Maxwell obtained Israeli passports for Semion Mogilevich and 23 associates, arranged a Bank of New York account for laundering, or helped the KGB. Nor do they establish that Trump knew of or participated in those alleged activities. The proposed entry should be narrowed to the yacht-party encounter alone; the original passport, banking and KGB claims should not appear in its description. The packet does not include a full event index, so this review cannot confirm that a separate record of the 1989 party is absent elsewhere.
